ingredients.name: fish fillets, such as cod, haddock, or tilapia
ground cayenne pepper, adjust to your spice preference
fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped, for garnish

steps.instruction: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a tajine or large pan over medium heat.
Add 1 finely chopped onion and 2 cloves of minced garlic.
Cook until the onion is translucent and fragrant.
Place 4 to 6 fish fillets in the pan.
Cook a few minutes on each side, until lightly browned.
Take the fish out of the pan and set it aside.
In the same pan, add 2 diced tomatoes and 1 tablespoon of tomato paste.
Add 1 teaspoon of ground cumin, 1 teaspoon of paprika and 1/2 teaspoon of cayenne pepper.
Add 1/2 teaspoon of ground coriander and 1/2 teaspoon of ground caraway seeds.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Mix the spices into the tomato mixture.
Pour in 1 cup of water and stir until the sauce is well combined.
Return the fish to the pan, nestling it into the sauce.
Cover with a lid and simmer for 10 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cover with a lid and let the fish simmer in the sauce for about 10 to 15 minutes, until it flakes easily with a fork.

steps.instruction: Take the pan off the heat.
Sprinkle chopped parsley or cilantro on top.
